deviation: The draft removes Arcadia's right to terminate for convenience entirely, allowing exit only for cause. This locks Arcadia into the contract for its full term, even if the supplier's performance is adequate but the need changes. That is worse than the fallback (90 days' notice after 12 months) and conflicts with the playbook's must-keep position.
suggested_text: The Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time by giving 30 days' written notice to the Supplier, without penalty.
